reference_sql:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend rows from July to October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
),
ranked AS (
  -- one row per campaign, with its place in its channel
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, clicks,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC, campaign_id) AS click_rank
  FROM campaign_clicks
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, clicks
FROM ranked
WHERE click_rank = 1
ORDER BY channel_id

WITH campaign_clicks AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend rows from July to October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
)
SELECT cc.channel_id, cc.campaign_id, cc.campaign_name, cc.clicks
FROM campaign_clicks AS cc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM campaign_clicks AS other
  WHERE other.channel_id = cc.channel_id
    AND (other.clicks > cc.clicks
         OR (other.clicks = cc.clicks AND other.campaign_id < cc.campaign_id))
)
ORDER BY cc.channel_id

WITH campaign_clicks AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend rows from July to October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily AS a
  JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
),
top_clicks AS (
  -- one row per channel, with the most clicks any of its campaigns had
  SELECT channel_id, MAX(clicks) AS max_clicks
  FROM campaign_clicks
  GROUP BY channel_id
),
leaders AS (
  -- one row per channel: the lowest campaign_id among its campaigns with the most clicks
  SELECT cc.channel_id, MIN(cc.campaign_id) AS campaign_id
  FROM campaign_clicks AS cc
  JOIN top_clicks AS t ON t.channel_id = cc.channel_id AND t.max_clicks = cc.clicks
  GROUP BY cc.channel_id
)
SELECT cc.channel_id, cc.campaign_id, cc.campaign_name, cc.clicks
FROM campaign_clicks AS cc
JOIN leaders AS l ON l.campaign_id = cc.campaign_id
ORDER BY cc.channel_id

solver.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT cp.channel_id, cp.campaign_id, cp.campaign_name, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY cp.channel_id, cp.campaign_id, cp.campaign_name
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, clicks
FROM t
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC, campaign_id ASC) = 1
ORDER BY channel_id ASC
